title: Billing accounts, their link to projects and who pays for what

videos.script: A billing account is what pays. It holds the card, or the invoice, and it adds up the costs of every project linked to it. {{account}} It does not live in the tree. It sits beside it, and one account can pay for projects in any folder. {{beside}} Billing has its own roles. The one to keep scarce is billing user. Whoever holds it decides which projects the company pays for. {{roles}} Linking takes both sides. A role on the account, and a role on the project. {{link}} In your lab, gcloud asks Google for your billing accounts, and Google refuses. Then Terraform plans a project linked to one, and a grant on the account. {{lab}} Unlinking is the switch that stops a project's paid services. Machines stop. Stored data may be deleted. {{unlink}} And who pays for what? The project that owns a resource. Except for network traffic, which the sender pays, and a shared network, which splits the bill. {{end}}
